summary: Rabbi Tawil goes through the conclusion of the Amidah, focusing on the themes of Elokai Netzor and Oseh Shalom. He explains the laws and customs of taking three steps back, bowing, and turning to the left and right before exiting the prayer.
questions: What is the meaning behind the words of Elokai Netzor?
Why do we take three steps back at the end of the Amidah?
How should a person physically move when saying Oseh Shalom Bimromav?
Can a person add personal supplications or forgot Al haNissim at the end of the Amidah?
What is the custom of reciting a Pasuk matching one's Hebrew name before Oseh Shalom?
